scope: Reuse local road identity formatter and snapshot timestamps once during over-budget boundary cache ordering

road_identity.implementation: One StringBuilder and java.util.Formatter per canonicalGeometryKey call; same Locale.US, %.5f,%.5f format, input doubles, forward/reverse order and lexical choice.
road_identity.equivalence: Actual baseline/current compiled private methods compare exact text for 200 seeded traces per SDK. Repository tests cover signed zero, half rounding, reversed routes, alternate default locales and persisted SQLite collision IDs.
road_identity.runtime: JDK21, Robolectric SDKs31/37; calling-thread allocation and wall/CPU time medians.
road_identity.method: 1000-coordinate fixture, four actual helper calls per sample, equal reflection overhead, eight warmup pairs and eleven alternating rounds.
road_identity.tradeoff: Retains one small local builder and formatter until this call completes, replacing per-coordinate instances; no shared state, geometry cache, rounding or saved-ID change.

cache_ordering.implementation: Only after the existing budget check, snapshot one lastModified timestamp per file under mutationLock; keep ascending timestamp, filename ties and stable input order, returning original File objects.
cache_ordering.method: 1024 real empty temporary files with deterministic shuffled timestamps; exact original comparator versus actual changed helper; three warmup pairs and seven alternating rounds, JDK21 Windows host with Robolectric SDKs31/37.
cache_ordering.tradeoff: One temporary timestamp record per file and list buffers during over-budget maintenance. Within-budget checks allocate no snapshot; no persistent metadata cache. Peak retained RAM was not measured.
cache_ordering.unchanged: 128 MiB / 6000-file caps, keep-current-write exclusion, delete/failure handling, counter updates, lifetimes and fresh timestamps on each later sort.

recent_tradeoff_review: Previously added per-batch saved-road parse reuse retains one tree for at most 16384 input characters; all fixes still query current roads and all acceptance gates remain.
Exact overlay publication retains one snapshot of already-loaded immutable data; bounds clear at the existing next-load boundary and equal refreshes release prior equal payloads.

Previously added compaction after an explicit stopped-data deletion can take longer and require temporary disk space; it runs after the delete commits and failure does not undo the successful deletion.
limits: Local allocation and Windows filesystem timing are not Android peak memory, physical battery, driving accuracy, provider credits, storage savings or fleet capacity measurements.
The cache timing measures sorting, not the complete eviction operation. File.lastModified invocation counts are not counts of physical disk reads.
Host CPU clock resolution is coarse; zero formatter CPU samples mean below resolution, not zero CPU use. No CPU percentage is claimed.
GPS, matching decisions, turns/gaps, distance, geometry, containment, town borders, saved data/schema, provider calls and all server/gateway code remain unchanged in this pass.
Current-head CI is separate from the fully green preceding revision and is tracked in the draft PR.
